week.name: This Afternoon
week.detailed: Rain before 5pm, then snow. Cloudy. High near 50, with temperatures falling to around 40 in the afternoon. North wind 3 to 8 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New snow accumulation of less than half an inch possible.

week.name: Wednesday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny. High near 41, with temperatures falling to around 39 in the afternoon. South southeast wind 1 to 5 mph.
week.night_short: Mostly Cloudy then Rain And Snow Likely

week.name: Thursday
week.detailed: Rain and snow before 2pm, then rain and snow. Cloudy, with a high near 41. South southeast wind around 5 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%. New snow accumulation of less than half an inch possible.

week.name: Friday
week.detailed: Rain and snow. Cloudy, with a high near 37. New snow accumulation of 1 to 3 inches possible.

week.name: Saturday
week.short: Slight Chance Light Snow then Partly Sunny
week.detailed: A slight chance of snow before 11am. Partly sunny, with a high near 36. New snow accumulation of less than half an inch possible.
week.night_short: Mostly Cloudy then Slight Chance Light Snow

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: A chance of snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 39.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: A chance of snow before 5pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 37.

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 17 at 10:05AM MST until November 18 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. For the Wasatch Mountains, forecast snow
totals of 4 to 8 inches above 8000 feet with locally higher amounts
in excess of 12 inches for the Upper Cottonwoods. For the Wasatch
Back, 1 to 4 inches with the highest amounts for Park City and the
Ogden valley.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains, and Wasatch Back.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM MST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult at times along mountain routes.
The hazardous conditions will impact the Tuesday evening commute on
higher passes such as Parleys Summit.

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 17 at 11:54AM MST until November 18 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Pocatello ID
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Moderate to heavy snow at times. Total snow accumulations
between 3 and 8 inches.

* WHERE...Bear River Range.  This includes Emigration Summit.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM MST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions.
